summary: Ares Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the renewal of its advisory agreement with Ares Commercial Real Estate Management LLC for one year through April 30, 2027, with immaterial amendments clarifying services for private placements. Separately, the company issued 5.4 million shares (Class S-PR and Class I-PR) for gross proceeds of ~$44.1 million in unregistered sales under Regulation D, including DRIP shares. This is a routine contractual renewal and equity offering, not a transformative event. No special-situation event is present.
